item.title: PyCharm IDE for Python development just got a big update
item.description: JetBrains dropped a major update for its Python IDE, PyCharm 2025.3.2. PyCharm and Google Colab are normally treated like separate tools, with the former PyCharm for that serious, heavy-duty local IDE power, and Colab for easy, GPU-accelerated cloud access. This update merges them. The best part is that this Colab functionality is included for free […]

item.title: Internet Archive free book: Printed Circuit Handbook
item.description: The Internet Archive is a treasure trove of information. The latest find in their collection is the book Printed Circuit Handbook by Clyde F. Coombs and Happy T. Holden. While it’s from 2016 (and a few things have happened since then), it still has some really good information. See it here.
